title: Zero-Overhead Introspection for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
selection_reason: ZIP-RC reuses unused logits in the same forward pass to predict reward and remaining length, then allocates test-time samples by expected utility; this directly reduces reasoning cost/latency without a second model.
